# {{{projectName}}}

{{{description}}}

The service uses only the built-in `node:http` module. It has no runtime dependencies.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or newer
- npm

## Install

```sh
npm install
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Run from source, reloading on change |
| `npm run build` | Compile TypeScript to `dist/` |
| `npm start` | Run the compiled server (`node dist/index.js`) |
| `npm run typecheck` | Type-check `src` and `test` without emitting |
| `npm test` | Run the test suite with vitest |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `{{{port}}}` | HTTP port to listen on (1-65535) |
| `HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Address to bind |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`; any other value falls back to `info` |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS` | `10000` | How long in-flight requests may run on shutdown before their connections are destroyed |
| `BODY_LIMIT_BYTES` | `1048576` | Maximum request body size in bytes |
{{#if cors}}
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | Value of `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`: `*` or one origin such as `https://app.example.com` |
{{/if}}

A non-numeric or out-of-range numeric value stops the server at startup with a logged error and exit code 1.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/health` | Liveness: `200 {"status":"ok"}` while the process can respond |
| `GET` | `/ready` | Readiness: `200 {"status":"ready"}` while listening; `503 {"status":"not_ready"}` before listening and once shutdown has started |
{{#if exampleResource}}
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items` | List items: `200 {"items":[...]}` |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/items` | Create an item from `{"name": "..."}` (1 to 100 characters): `201`, with a `Location` header |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Get one item: `200`, or `404` |
| `PUT` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Rename an item from `{"name": "..."}`: `200`, `400` or `404` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/items/:id` | Delete an item: `204`, or `404` |

The item store is in memory and local to the process. It starts empty and is lost on restart.
{{/if}}

Errors are JSON, for example `{"error":{"code":"not_found","message":"No route matches /nope"}}`.

## Logging

Each log line is one JSON object on stdout. Every request logs one line when it completes. Requests to `/health` and `/ready` log at `debug` level.

```json
{"time":"2026-01-02T03:04:05.678Z","level":"info","msg":"request completed","service":"{{{projectName}}}","method":"GET","path":"/nope","status":404,"durationMs":0.42,"requestId":"6f1c2b7e-0d7a-4a7e-9f0e-2b1d3c4e5f60"}
```

An incoming `x-request-id` header is kept and echoed in the response. Otherwise a UUID is generated.

## Graceful shutdown

On `SIGTERM` or `SIGINT` the server:

1. marks itself not ready, so `/ready` returns 503;
2. stops accepting connections and closes idle keep-alive connections;
3. waits for in-flight requests to finish, for up to `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS`;
4. exits with code 0. If the timeout was reached, it destroys the remaining connections and exits with code 1.

Later signals during shutdown are ignored. Responses sent during shutdown include `Connection: close`.
{{#if cors}}

## CORS

Every response carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` set to `CORS_ORIGIN`. When that is a specific origin, `Vary: Origin` is also set.

`OPTIONS` requests with an `Access-Control-Request-Method` header are preflight requests. They get `204` before routing, for any path, with `Access-Control-Allow-Methods`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` (echoing the requested headers, or `content-type,x-request-id`) and `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600`.
{{/if}}
{{#if docker}}

## Docker

```sh
docker build -t {{{projectName}}} .
docker run --rm -p {{{port}}}:{{{port}}} {{{projectName}}}
curl -i localhost:{{{port}}}/health
```

The image runs as the non-root `node` user and listens on port {{{port}}}.
{{/if}}

# Build stage: compile TypeScript.
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json* tsconfig.json ./
RUN if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi
COPY src ./src
RUN npm run build

# Runtime stage: compiled output and production dependencies only.
FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT={{{port}}}
COPY package.json package-lock.json* ./
RUN if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --omit=dev; else npm install --omit=dev; fi
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
USER node
EXPOSE {{{port}}}
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
